import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter features with strong associations (|t| > 3.5)
    t_stats = np.array([abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)], 
                                           feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])[0]) 
                        for fid in feats.ids])
    strong_features = [fid for fid, t in zip(feats.ids, t_stats) if t > 3.5]
    
    # If no strong features, return empty design
    if not strong_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build correlation matrix for strong features
    X_strong = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in strong_features]]
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X_strong.T)
    
    # Cluster features with high correlations (|r| >= 0.6)
    mask = np.abs(corr_matrix) >= 0.6
    np.fill_diagonal(mask, False)
    
    # Use Agglomerative Clustering to find modules
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, 
                                         distance_threshold=1-0.6,
                                         linkage='complete')
    clusters = clustering.fit_predict(1 - np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Find the largest cluster
    unique_clusters, counts = np.unique(clusters, return_counts=True)
    main_cluster = unique_clusters[np.argmax(counts)]
    
    # Get module members
    module_members = [strong_features[i] for i in range(len(strong_features)) 
                      if clusters[i] == main_cluster]
    
    # If single feature, use it as driver
    if len(module_members) <= 1:
        return Design(drivers=(module_members[0],), 
                      columns=module_members, 
                      products=(), 
                      loadings={module_members[0]: 1.0})
    
    # Compute weighted score using first principal component
    X_module = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in module_members]]
    _, _, Vt = np.linalg.svd(X_module, full_matrices=False)
    weights = Vt[0] / np.linalg.norm(Vt[0])
    loadings = dict(zip(module_members, weights))
    
    # Return best single driver (highest absolute loading) and full module
    driver = max(loadings.keys(), key=lambda k: abs(loadings[k]))
    
    return Design(drivers=(driver,), 
                  columns=module_members, 
                  products=(), 
                  loadings=loadings)
